artifact.installedAndChecked: the installed XPI hash reported by scripts/host/install.js equals this value

host.profile: isolated .local/profile with .local/data; the personal library was not opened

method: python3 scripts/make-ui-fixture.py; scripts/host/install.js, load.js, seed-ui.js, capture-ui.js. For each language and each width the real dialog was analysed and the unique, doubtful and long-quote cases were selected (plus ambiguous and not-found at 1180 px). Layout metrics were collected from the live DOM and PNG screenshots were read for wording and balance.
notes: Screenshots were read for every language. The annotation list intentionally clamps a long quote to two lines and scrolls when there are more rows than fit. Fixes made after the first runs: annotation types and the outcome line are now localized, and the Japanese and Russian status wording was revised.
